data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 Syndicate 1969 had opening gross claims outstanding of $568.26m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates aggregate adverse prior-year development of approximately $39.9m (about 7.0% of opening reserves), driven principally by adverse development in casualty (Non-Marine Liability) from a number of large US losses and a strengthening of IBNR/reserving assumptions. The syndicate's narrative also highlights a net deterioration of $9.07m within calendar year claims incurred (net of reinsurance). A range of named catastrophe events from 2017-2019 (notably the 2017 hurricanes and 2018 US/Asia events) materially influenced reserve setting and remediation actions have been implemented.

We have responded to the development of new claims and previously notified events on our "watch list" and strengthened reserves for incurred but not reported claims, where appropriate

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative incurred gross claims current diagonals) and excludes the two most recent underwriting years per the methodology. The report also explicitly states a net prior-year deterioration of $9.07m (net of reinsurance); that net figure was NOT used as the primary PYD figure because a gross movement was available only via the triangle. Some LOB-level prior-year movements are described qualitatively only (not quantified), so LOB movement amounts are null where not specified. Page references are taken from the report sections where the items appear.
